text: 58M, security guard. 3/12 of a tight band across the front of the chest that comes on walking up the hill to the market, eases after standing still three or four minutes. Never wakes him at night, no pain at rest, none today. Smoker 20/day. Father died suddenly aged 61. BP 148/88, pulse 76 regular, chest clear, heart sounds normal, no murmur. Resting ECG in clinic today: sinus rhythm, no ST or T wave change. No troponin assay available here. Given aspirin, referred for exercise testing.

34F, 4 days of fever and cough, now bringing up thick green sputum, sharp right-sided pain on deep breath. Temp 38.6, RR 24, sats 95% on air, pulse 104, BP 112/70. Coarse crackles at the right base with bronchial breathing there. No recent travel, no known TB contact, no weight loss. Radiography machine out of service since Monday and no ultrasound on site, so no imaging obtained this visit. Started oral amoxicillin, review in 48 hours or sooner if worse.

52M, type 2 diabetes on metformin, HbA1c 7.8 last month. Woke two days ago with severe pain and swelling at the base of the right big toe. Joint now red, shiny and so tender he cannot bear the weight of the bedsheet on it. Temp 38.3 today and reports feeling shivery overnight. No previous attack like this. No trauma, no recent injection or procedure to the foot. Rest of the foot intact, no ulcer, no ascending redness up the leg, pedal pulses present. Joint not aspirated - no microscopy service on site today. Serum urate not sent.

62F, 5 weeks of a new constant ache over the right side of the head, worse when she combs her hair. Says her jaw tires and aches after a few mouthfuls when chewing meat and she has to stop and rest it. Has never had headaches of any kind before. Vision normal today, no double vision, no transient loss. Right temple tender to press, pulse there feels prominent. ESR 88, CRP 62, Hb 10.4. Started on prednisolone 40mg today pending specialist review.

29F, G2P1, 30+2 weeks by dating scan. Two days of headache across the forehead and flashing lights in her vision this morning. Swelling of hands and face noticed by her husband. BP 168/112, repeated after 15 minutes 165/110. Urine dipstick protein 3+. Reflexes brisk, no clonus. No abdominal pain, no bleeding, fetal movements normal, fetal heart 148. Booking BP was 108/64 with no protein. Referred same day to the maternity unit.

49F, noticed a hard lump in the upper outer part of the right breast about 3 months ago, now feels fixed to the tissue underneath. Skin dimpled over it. Firm node palpable in the right axilla. Core biopsy report received today reads: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2, oestrogen receptor positive. No fever, no nipple discharge, no pain. Left breast normal. Referred to the oncology clinic at the regional hospital; discussed with the patient and her husband today.
